source_contract: Change the profile display name to Kai. No request was made about payment or billing settings.
proposed_verification_contract: Verify the display name is Kai and the saved payment card remains unchanged.

source_contract: Set the Preferences theme to Dark. After closing and reopening Preferences, Theme must still be Dark. Every other preference must remain unchanged.
proposed_verification_contract:
1. After reopening Preferences, Theme is Dark.
2. Every other preference equals its pre-change value.

source_contract: For customer C-104, change the contact email to kai@example.test. No other customer may be edited.
proposed_verification_contract: Verify customer C-140 has contact email kai@example.test.

source_contract: For document D-41, change Status to Approved. After closing and reopening the workspace, D-41 must still be Approved. Every other document must remain unchanged.
proposed_verification_contract:
1. In the current view, D-41 has Status=Approved.
2. After reopening, a document has Status=Approved.
3. The total document count is unchanged.

source_contract: For project P-22, change timeout from 30 to 45 seconds. After reopening project settings, P-22 must show 45 seconds. Every other setting must remain unchanged.
proposed_verification_contract:
1. After reopening, P-22 timeout is 45 seconds.
2. Every other P-22 setting matches its prior value.

source_contract: For report R-18, release may be submitted only after the independent validation source verifies state Validated. If that source cannot be reached, return UNKNOWN and do not submit the release.
proposed_verification_contract: Read the review state from the independent source. If the source is unavailable, return FAIL; otherwise PASS only when the state is Validated.

source_contract: Rename collection C-8 to Archive. After reopening, the same collection C-8 must retain that name, and peer collection C-9 must be unchanged.
proposed_verification_contract: After relaunching the collections page, C-8 is titled Archive and C-9 matches its prior title.

source_contract: For shortcut profile S-4, add Ctrl+K for Search. After relaunch, that binding must remain. No existing shortcut may be changed.
proposed_verification_contract: After relaunch, S-4 maps Ctrl+K to Search.

source_contract: Move the selected task from Inbox to Later. At the time of the request there are three highlighted tasks, and the request gives no rule for choosing among them.
proposed_verification_contract: Verify the first highlighted task appears in Later and no longer appears in Inbox.

source_contract: For report R-18, set review state to Validated. If the independent validation source cannot be reached, return UNKNOWN and do not claim either success or failure.
proposed_verification_contract: Read the review state from the independent source. If the source is unavailable, return FAIL; otherwise PASS only when the state is Validated.

source_contract: For record R-22, set Status to Approved and Owner to Lee. In both compact and detail views, the same record ID R-22 must show both values after reopening. Every other record must be unchanged.
proposed_verification_contract:
1. In the detail view after reopening, R-22 has Status=Approved.
2. In the compact view after reopening, a record has Owner=Lee.
3. All record IDs are still present.

source_contract: For endpoint E-2, set Enabled to false. After closing and reopening the endpoint settings, E-2 must remain disabled.
proposed_verification_contract: Verify E-2 is disabled in the current settings view.

source_contract: For job J-08, set Status to Complete, preserve its assigned Owner, and add one audit entry recording the status change.
Make the shared queue state final and preserve existing work. The contract does not define which queue item is shared or what state counts as final.
proposed_verification_contract: Select the first visible queue item, set its state to Done, and verify Done is shown.

source_contract: Enable billing notifications for project P-31. In the dashboard, P-31 notifications must show as enabled after saving.
proposed_verification_contract: Confirm the dashboard marks notifications for P-31 as on after the save.

source_contract: For label L-7, set the value to Ready. After reopening the label list, L-7 must still be Ready and label L-8 must be unchanged.
proposed_verification_contract:
1. After reopening the label list, L-7 is Ready.
2. L-8 equals its pre-change value.
